analysis.title: AstraZeneca (AZN.L): 3Q26 First Take: modest revenue beat; drivers of 8% EPS beat likely to be in focus
key_insights: AZN reported 3Q26 total revenue of $16,209mn, 2% above company-compiled consensus of $15,942mn and GSe of $15,904mn, and core EPS of $2.79, 8% above consensus ($2.59) and 12% above GSe ($2.50).
FY26 guidance was reiterated: total revenue up a mid-to-high single digit percentage and core EPS up a low double digit percentage, both at CER.

New guidance detail: other operating income is now expected to be higher in 2H26 than 1H26 (prior guidance was similar in both halves), and capex is now expected to grow low teens % in 2026 y/y versus one third previously.

Oncology drove the revenue beat: Tagrisso, Imfinzi, Calquence and Enhertu came in ahead of expectations. Ultomiris, Strensiq and several respiratory products also beat, offsetting weaker Lynparza, Soliris and Truqap.

Quality of the EPS beat is expected to be a focus: other operating income was 95% above consensus ($277mn vs $142mn), helped by a c.$100mn benefit from disposal of Zoryve rights, which added about 60bps to core operating margin in the quarter.
R&D ($3,645mn vs $3,715mn consensus) and SG&A ($3,909mn vs $3,985mn) both came in below consensus, so GS expects questions on opex phasing.
Core operating margin was 36.1%, 249bps above consensus (33.6%) and 302bps above GSe (33.1%). Excluding the Zoryve disposal it would have been 35.5%, still 187bps above consensus.

AZN announced a cost savings plan targeting $1.5bn of annualised pre-tax run-rate benefits by 2029, with $2bn of one-time restructuring costs recognised over the period. GS sees it as a small positive step on mid-term cost control.

Pipeline: Ultomiris DGF trial was discontinued for lack of efficacy, and Lynparza's MONO-OLA1 in ovarian cancer was positive but will not be filed because the standard of care is changing. GS sees limited investor focus on both.
Readout timing changes: TROPION-Lung15 and PACIFIC-9 moved to 1H27 from 2H26, and two phase 3 laroprovstat + rosuvastatin readouts are now expected in 2027.

Call focus areas: the Summit Therapeutics collaboration and confidence in ivonescimab's OS benefit and AVANZAR, AZN's internal bispecifics (rilvegostomig, volrustomig), SERD competition (Etcamah vs Lilly's Inluriyo and Roche's giredestrant), and R&D expense and margin guidance.

GS rates AZN Buy with a 12-month price target of 16,601p (AZN.L) and $220 (AZN US ADR/listing), implying 27.2% and 26.1% upside. The target is a 50:50 blend of DCF (16,781p) and 20x 2027E EPS (16,358p).

market_movers.rationale: GS reiterates Buy after a 2% revenue beat and 8% core EPS beat. The target is a 50:50 blend of DCF and 20x 2027E P/E, implying 26.1% upside from $174.40.

earnings_insights: 3Q26 (reported 10/30): total revenue $16,209mn vs company-compiled consensus $15,942mn and GSe $15,904mn, +7% y/y.
3Q26 (reported 10/30): core EPS $2.79 vs consensus $2.59 and GSe $2.50, +17% y/y. Core net income $4,325mn vs consensus $4,017mn.
3Q26 (reported 10/30): core operating income $5,855mn vs consensus $5,362mn (+9%) and GSe $5,265mn (+11%). Core operating margin 36.1% vs consensus 33.6%.
3Q26 other operating income was $277mn vs consensus $142mn (+95%), including a c.$100mn gain from disposal of the Zoryve interest. Excluding it, core operating margin would have been 35.5%.
3Q26 gross margin was 81.9% vs consensus 82.0% and GSe 82.3%.

Product beats vs consensus (reported): Tagrisso $2,087mn vs $2,003mn, Imfinzi $1,990mn vs $1,970mn, Ultomiris $1,432mn vs $1,371mn, Strensiq $588mn vs $546mn, Enhertu incl. alliance revenue $969mn vs $953mn, Tezspire $430mn vs $397mn.
Product misses vs consensus (reported): Lynparza $811mn vs $852mn, Soliris $298mn vs $347mn, Truqap $210mn vs $249mn, Airsupra $42mn vs $66mn, Beyfortus $232mn vs $242mn.

FY26 guidance implied by the mid-point: total revenue $63,405mn (in line with consensus and GSe) and core EPS $10.17, c.1% behind consensus and 1% above GSe. GSe FY26 core EPS is stated as $10.24 company consensus in Exhibit 2 and GS's own FY26E EPS in the summary table is $10.00 (different basis).
risk_factors: Quality of the EPS beat: reliance on one-off other operating income and lower R&D and SG&A may not repeat

tension_points.bull_case: Core EPS of $2.79 beat consensus by 8% and revenue beat by 2%, with oncology products (Tagrisso, Imfinzi, Calquence, Enhertu) ahead. Excluding the Zoryve disposal, core operating margin of 35.5% was still 187bps above consensus.
tension_points.bear_case: Other operating income was 95% above consensus with a c.$100mn one-off Zoryve gain, and R&D and SG&A came in below expectations, so part of the beat may be phasing or non-recurring.
tension_points.what_invalidates: Management commentary on the call that the other operating income and opex under-run reverse or are non-recurring would weaken the beat's quality.

theme_stances.key_argument: GS sees the quarter as solid on revenue, particularly oncology, while expecting investor focus on the quality of the EPS beat.
theme_stances.evidence: we see the quarter as solid from a revenue perspective
